name: Dorfstadl
beschreibung: The Dorfstadl in Tirol is a traditional inn in a quiet location on the edge of the village. The surrounding mountain scenery is ideal for hikes and ski tours. The house has cozy rooms in Alpine style and a guest parlor with fireplace. The local cuisine emphasizes regional products. The atmosphere is relaxed and practical. A guest garden invites you to linger in summer. The inn is particularly aimed at hikers and families looking for down-to-earth accommodation.
